title: Angi vs Thumbtack: Which Platform is Best for Your Business?

facts.fact: Angi's listings cover around 720 specific home improvement and repair services, according to the article.
facts.quote: The platform offers listings for around 720 specific home improvement and repair services

facts.fact: Thumbtack covers more than 900 unique services, according to the article.
facts.quote: Covering more than **900 unique services across 13 distinct industries**

facts.fact: Thumbtack has over 10 million users across various industries, according to the article.
facts.quote: it boasts **over 10 million users** across various industries

facts.fact: Joining Angi is free, but businesses are charged fees to advertise and become more visible in customer searches.
facts.quote: While it is free to join Angi, businesses are charged fees to advertise their services

facts.fact: Angi's advertising pricing is negotiable based on advertising needs, and there is no flat annual fee for basic functionalities.
facts.quote: there is no flat annual fee for basic functionalities

facts.fact: Thumbtack uses a credit system in which professionals buy credits to communicate with leads, with no annual flat fee.
facts.quote: This system is **pay-as-you-go**, and there is no annual flat fee

facts.fact: On Thumbtack, each lead costs a number of credits that varies with the job's complexity, demand, and location.
facts.quote: Each lead costs a certain number of credits, which can vary depending on the job’s complexity, demand, and location.

facts.fact: The article was published on September 25, 2024.
